name: Group rejected products in one notification per producer -- @1.1
fullName: Notify producers about CSV processing and rejected products: Group rejected products in one notification per producer

steps.name: Given the RDB user is authenticated as "producer"
And the RDB initiative is "A"
And RDB notifications are observed
Given the RDB operational email was set to "rdb@example.it"
And RDB product "X" has initial status "UPLOADED"
And RDB product "Y" has initial status "UPLOADED"
And the RDB user is authenticated as "Invitalia"
When the RDB user changes products "X" from "UPLOADED" to "REJECTED"
Then the RDB operation has outcome "OK"
And one RDB rejection notification for products "X" is sent to "rdb@example.it"

labels.name: feature
labels.value: Notify producers about CSV processing and rejected products
